nodes.label: Issue #84 Offline Catchup Implementation
nodes.rationale: Three complementary mechanisms so offline agent messages are not lost: fixed clientId + clean:false persistent MQTT sessions let the broker queue QoS1 messages; server persists spawn params in participant.metadata.spawn and resends agent.spawn when the gateway comes online; gateway keeps per-agent-per-room watermark cursors in a node:sqlite state DB (EDGE_STATE_DB, default ~/.opc-gateway/state.db) and incrementally pulls history over HTTP with idempotent dedup against broker-queued overlap.
